Title: Action recommended: Prepare for model version retirement in Azure OpenAI

Body.Content:
On 5 July 2024, we'll begin updating Azure OpenAI deployments that use the model indicated in the Account information section of the email sent to account administrators to stop inference traffic. The update will be completed within two weeks of that date.

Recommended action:

Migrate your applications and workflows that use the model indicated in the Account information section of the email sent to account administrators to a replacement model by 5 July 2024 to ensure they'll continue working as expected after the retirement.

Help and support:

If you have questions, ask community experts in Microsoft Q&A. If you have a support plan and you need technical help, please create a support request:

  1. For Issue type, select Technical.
  2. For Subscription, select your subscription.
  3. For Service, select My services.
  4. For Service type, select Cognitive Services.
  5. For Resource, select the resource you need help with.
  6. For Summary, type a description of your issue.
  7. For Problem type, select Model Availability or Access.
  8. For Problem subtype, select Unable to find a model.

Learn more about service retirements that may impact your resources in the Azure Retirement Workbook. Please note that retirements may not be visible in the workbook for up to two weeks after being announced.
